title: Apple iPhone 17 Pro Max 256GB $1899.99 Delivered @ Costco Wholesale ($1804.99 Price Beat @ Officeworks)
body:
Deal: Apple iPhone 17 Pro Max 256GB $1899.99 Delivered @ Costco Wholesale ($1804.99 Price Beat @ Officeworks)

[TechNerd] They recently removed that exclusion. The person at checkout mentioned they don’t price match Costco. Then the manager said it should be okay when I brought up the new price match policy
[Arthas91] Since when were officeworks workers actually reasonable when it comes to price matching, always felt like i was going up against a brick wall every time. not worth the excessive amount of stress going through that debate with someone with a single brain cell.
[theUnderdog] Depends on the store. Camberwell Vic has been very reasonable
[Hahuh] Call em up.
https://www.officeworks.com.au/information/policies/price-be…
[Arthas91] @Hahuh: Comes with its own limitations mate, like only 1 gift card per transaction
[TechNerd] It’s always a never ending cycle of waiting. Although the new phones are predicted to be priced slightly higher
[zmwang] Since semi conductor stock drop so much, maybe cheaper:)
[HaydosK] Definitely wait for the 18 pro max. 2nm chip and smaller dynamic island are the biggest upgrades in 5 years.
[Mi2] They literally used to say this about iPhone 17 with the new design.
I got tired of all this bs and no longer follow or care about the incremental upgrades in tech.
It no longer makes any sense.
You would live the same life with 2nm as you did with 3nm. 18 pro max's would be at least $100 or even $200 more expensive.
Is it really worth paying $500-600 more for what you mentioned?
[HaydosK] "They literally used to say this about iPhone 17 with the new design."
Well the 17 did change a lot and got better cameras and cooling from the new housing and vapor chamber but screen, battery life and performance on the 18 will be much better because this is the first nm upgrade since the iphone 15 and first dynamic island change since the iphone 14. This is like the ultimate version of the 17.
"I got tired of all this bs and no longer follow or care about the incremental upgrades in tech.
It no longer makes any sense."
I agree but that doesn't mean you shouldn't look at what comes next or the differences. Don't upgrade every year but every few years when enough changes it's worth it.
"You would live the same life with 2nm as you did with 3nm. 18 pro max's would be at least $100 or even $200 more expensive."
Yes but when you buy a phone it's an investment. Iphones with the old notch style are outdated now and so will the old dynamic island once there are a few generations of smaller dynamic island phones. You could still easily use an iphone 14 with all the same features as the new phones.
Is it really worth paying $500-600 more for what you mentioned.
Well that's up to you. How do you know they won't have another sale for that? It really depends how desperate you are to get a new phone.
[yummypinacolada] IPhone usually do complete upgrade and redesign every 3 generations. Introducing 3 cemeras on the pro 11,12,13 -> then they introduce dynamic island on 14,15,16 ->then 17 they have new design and new vapour chamber cooling.
If the trend continues, 18 and 19 will just have a spec bump with the same design. Sure, better chipset, cameras, battery, etc. But the experience wouldnt change from the 17
[alexGoodwin] and also 1st ever foldable iphone, i'm waiting for that
[Hahuh] Big talks about the 18 being more expensive due to ram prices. It's going to be universal across all phones.
If you want to pay +$400 for essentially the same phone next year; then wait.
[stirlo] That’s my worry. Though I suspect is will be +$500 on the pro models
[SpeedRunnerLink] Depends what phone you currently have and if it’s worth spending money.
I’m still using an IP14 pro max and have no issues with it at all since launch.
[TechNerd] It should be same price in store if they have it in stock
[Lizard Spock] RIP Tennis2021. I will always be reminded of you whenever I see a smelly sock.
